payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that among the three pre-training tasks, Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective for pre-training models, as it requires a comprehensive understanding of documents.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task compared to Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
SR works slightly better than NSG and MDG in pre-training tasks.
The effectiveness of SR is attributed to its requirement for a comprehensive understanding of documents, which is essential for abstractive document summarization.
